name: **[Storra (Cloud Storage Platform)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Personal-Google-Drive)** | Node.js, React.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, AWS
highlights: Developed a secure cloud storage API for uploads, downloads, streaming previews, and metadata management.
Engineered role-based access control and OTP plus Google/GitHub OAuth authentication for secure file sharing.
Implemented protections against SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and DoS attacks and validated behavior through extensive API testing.

name: **[Video Streaming Platform](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Video-Streaming)** | AWS, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Docker
highlights: Built an event-driven video pipeline with S3, Lambda, ECS Fargate, and FFmpeg for automatic transcoding.
Generated 360p, 480p, and 720p HLS renditions and delivered videos through CloudFront signed cookies.

name: **[ShipIt (Self-Hosted CI/CD Server)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Storra)** | Node.js, GitHub Webhooks, AWS S3, CloudFront
highlights: Automated repeatable application deployments through GitHub webhooks with branch-based workflows and rollback on health-check failures.
Tracked deployment status and notifications through GitHub Commit Status and Telegram APIs; retained Redis-backed logs for seven days.

name: **[ProxyRaQ(Multithreaded Proxy Web Server)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/ProxyRaQ)** | C, Thread Pool, Sockets, HTTP
highlights: Built a multithreaded HTTP proxy with a thread pool, client queue, mutex-protected LRU cache, and low-level request parsing.
